s: Shello lehapsiq keneged hammitpallel ubo h' seipim: asur lesheb betok d' ammot shel hammitpallel, ben millepanayv, ben milleacharayv, ben min hatztzedadim — tzarik leharchiq d' ammot, ki hammaqom asher hammitpallel omed alayv admat qodesh hu, hoil ushekina kenegdo kemo shennitbaer besiman tz"z, vetzarik linhog kabod bemaqom zeh kol zeman shehu mitpallel, umeqomo shel adam hu d' ammot. Veim eno rotzeh lihyot yosheb ubatel sham ella asuq battora o beshirot vetishbachot — muttar lesheb, shekkesheoseq sham bedibre qedushsha — en genay bishibato sham. Vehu shemmotzi dibre tora bepiv, abal hirhur bedibre tora — eno moil lazeh, shehirhur eno nireh vishibato niret genay lemaqom qadosh:

Yesh mi sheomer sheim hayyosheb betzad hammitpallel hu challash — muttar lo lesheb, sheen yeshibato niret genay, lepi shechulshato mokachat alayv shemmippene kak yosheb, veyesh lismok al debarayv im i epshar lo beqal leharchiq d' ammot velesheb sham:

Im hayyosheb yashab kebar veamad zeh betziddo lehitpallel — en tzarik laqum, shehare zeh ba bigbulo. Vehu shemmitpallel bebayit shello yichaduhu litpilla, abal bebet hakkeneset sheyyichaduhu litpilla — tzarik laqum, mippene shehu maqom hamyuchad lakkol, velo shayyak lomar zeh ba bigbulo. Vaapillu bebeto — middat chasidut hu laqum, kede leharim mikshol mechabero sheoseh shello kashshura sheamad lehitpallel betok d' ammot shel hayyosheb kebar behetter veeno mechuyyab laqum mippanayv, vishibato hi genay lemaqom qadosh:

Asur laabor keneged hammitpalelin betok d' ammot shellipnehem, shemma titbattel kavvanatam. Abal betziddehem muttar laabor velaamod sham, velo yelek lehalea shello yihyeh keneged penehem, shekkol sheyyukal liroto — asur, mippene shemmitbattelet kavvanato. Vechakme hazzohar oserim apillu betziddehem tok d' ammot:

Im hishlim tepillato vehaya adam echad mitpallel acharayv — asur lipsoa g' pesiot ad sheyyigmor mi sheacharayv et tepillato, sheim yipsa qodem laken — hare hu ober keneged hammitpallel. Vetzarik ledaqdeq bazeh apillu im haacharon hitchil lehitpallel acharayv, meachar shekkebar hitchil:
